sources.title: New General Service List 1.2 with basic statistics
sources.attribution: New General Service List 1.2 by Charles Browne, Brent Culligan, and Joseph Phillips, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Cite the NGSL project when reusing this derived frequency layer.
sources.changeNotice: The app normalizes single-token lemmas, maps source rank into six NGSL frequency bands, merges the result with other declared layers, and adds only the separately documented conservative inflections.

sources.title: New Academic Word List 1.2 lemmatized for research
sources.attribution: New Academic Word List 1.2 by Charles Browne, Brent Culligan, and Joseph Phillips, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. The official page describes the list as 957 words; this fixed research CSV contains 959 distinct lemma rows and is retained without silent deletion.
sources.changeNotice: The app retains each source headword as academic membership, does not promote comma-separated observations into forms, merges the result with other declared layers, and adds only the separately documented conservative inflections.

sources.title: ECDICT full CSV, audited subset only
sources.attribution: ECDICT by Linwei, MIT License. The full 770,611-record source file is never bundled; only manually reviewed high senses and compact automatically screened Chinese learning senses for separately selected candidates are shipped.
sources.changeNotice: The app ships only manually reviewed high senses and compact automatically screened common Chinese learning senses for candidates selected by declared frequency, academic, public exam-focus, or lookup-frequency inputs. It excludes the full database, domain-tagged senses, abbreviations, proper-name-first entries, invalid POS, and entries without Chinese learning glosses.

sources.title: wordfreq 3.2.0 large English frequency snapshot
sources.attribution: wordfreq 3.2.0 English data by Robyn Speer. The included data files are redistributable under CC BY-SA 4.0; retain attribution to Robyn Speer and the source notices described in wordfreq NOTICE.md.
sources.changeNotice: The app decodes the checksum-pinned cBpack v1 snapshot, retains only normalized single-token [a-z]+ English forms, ranks the first 25,000 by Zipf frequency, and emits a lookupFrequency layer. This lookup-only layer does not replace NGSL frequency bands, NAWL academic membership, CET direction labels, or article-quality thresholds.
